title: Ecommerce Platforms

market_size.scope: global retail ecommerce sales (the market these platforms serve)
market_size.note: Total retail ecommerce sales, not the platform-software market; free coverage only.

market_context: Shopify reports it is the ecommerce platform behind millions of businesses in 175+ countries, indicating broad global adoption (per Apple App Store, https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shopify-sell-run-a-business/id371294472).
Store Leads says WooCommerce and Shopify dominate by merchant count, with Shopify growing slightly faster and having greater mindshare (per Store Leads, https://storeleads.app/reports).
BigCommerce is positioning its new parent brand 'Commerce' around an AI-driven future, bundling BigCommerce, Feedonomics and Makeswift (per BigCommerce, https://www.bigcommerce.com/press/releases/).
Salesforce Commerce Cloud emphasizes AI-driven commerce embedded across the customer lifecycle as a platform differentiator (per Salesforce, https://www.salesforce.com/commerce/).
